en: The postcard shows a sepia-toned view of historic architecture in Florence, Italy. It prominently features the Palazzo Vecchio with its tall clock tower in the center, the Uffizi Gallery buildings framing the foreground, and the iconic dome of the Florence Cathedral (Duomo di Firenze) in the background. The image captures a view down a narrow street filled with pedestrians, typical of early 20th-century postcards.
